This '''[[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]]''' was used by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[R8-B7/Legends|R8-B7]] was the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] assigned to Windu and the fighter. When R8-B7 was destroyed, [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] commandeered the ship.
